Added runestone icons for 20 stones, with the levelled ones picking their icon from the enchantment level

Added a Fish toggle to the tier config screen

Improved performance of tier icon rendering
3.6.0: Added a Spawners toggle to the tier config screen
Added a chat message when a new version is available, with CurseForge and Modrinth links

3.0.2: Improved JSON file handling and error recovery
Added `SERVER_DEFAULT` option for skill message type
Refactored GUI classes with reusable `ScreenWithList` and `ChildScreenWithList`
3.1.0: Configurable volume for quest complete, gemstone, level up, bomb, RTP, llama/elevator, mushroom, mithril core, vein miner, and treefeller sounds
Sound settings accessible from vanilla Sound Options screen
3.2.0: Added homes screen caching — opens instantly from cache on subsequent uses, refreshes in background
Added XP tracking alongside money earnings with unified processing
Migrated to multi-loader architecture (Forge, Fabric, NeoForge from a single codebase)
